name: Commander Vault
blurb: Ten painted sets of five: full-art staples and iconic legends built for the 100-card table.
blurbEs: Diez sets pintados de cinco: clásicos de arte completo y leyendas icónicas para mesas de cien cartas.

sets.name: Astral Constellation
sets.style: Illuminated celestial star-chart painting: deep lapis lazuli and midnight indigo wash, delicate gold-leaf constellation lines and orbital arcs, restrained pale cream highlights, matte parchment tooth.

items.subject: a tall stone observatory spire rising into a star-mapped night sky, five subtle colored starlight beams converging on its crown
a quiet scholar at a brass astrolabe desk as luminous star-threads drift from nearby lanterns into open books
a colossal spiral vortex of night sea and starlight lifting distant ships and stone arches skyward
a translucent celestial fish gliding along the wake of a passing starlit leviathan, trailing fine gold filaments
an interlocking brass ring snapping shut around a flaring comet mid-flight, scattering quiet sparks

sets.name: Botanical Herbarium
sets.style: Nineteenth-century natural history botanical plate: fine sepia copperplate ink lines over translucent sage, moss and viridian watercolour washes on warm aged rag paper, gentle ochre accents.

items.subject: two freshly sprouted saplings sharing intertwined roots over dark fertile loam and a meandering forest brook
ancient mossy tree limbs stretching across a misty ravine to link two cliffside groves in morning light
lush fern fronds and wild vines unfurling rapidly across cracked mossy paving stones
a sunbeam breaking through a cathedral canopy of tall pines onto a mossy woodland trail
three stone footbridges winding through tiered terraced hills of willow, bamboo and wildflowers

sets.name: Alchemist's Brass
sets.style: Renaissance workshop still-life in oil and warm ochre glaze: burnished brass, blown amber glass, dark walnut bench shadows, crisp specular highlights, painterly brushwork.

items.subject: a faceted dark stone resting in a brass cradle, faintly reflecting the warm hues of surrounding coloured glass flasks
an ornate brass lantern with five tinted glass panes casting a soft prismatic halo across a shadowy stone table
a heavy bronze flywheel and copper coils humming with warm amber light inside a vaulted workshop
a hand-forged golden lotus sculpture opening its metallic petals over a dark reflective obsidian bowl
a small brass compass-sphere hanging from a leather cord beside folded maps and a travelling lantern

sets.name: Catacomb Etching
sets.style: Dramatic chiaroscuro etching and charcoal wash: deep plum-black shadows, silvery bone highlights, cross-hatched stonework, single cold candlelit focal point.

items.subject: a pale armoured hand rising out of cracked crypt flagstones as silver smoke curls upward from a candle flame
fine luminous threads pulling a shrouded knight upright from a sunken marble sarcophagus
three hooded figures gathered around a brazier whose violet-black flame stretches high into a vaulted chamber
a towering horned shadow leaning over a candlelit lectern, turning a single heavy page for a small cloaked scholar
a sunken circular pit ringed with iron arches and bone pillars under a stark overhead shaft of cold light

sets.name: Sunforge Mosaic
sets.style: Byzantine gold-leaf and alabaster mosaic painting: warm ivory, burnished gold tesserae, terracotta and ultramarine accents, crisp mortar seams, monumental sacred geometry.

items.subject: a lone cloaked silhouette walking down a sunlit golden road out of a walled marble city toward open fields
a vast pillar of blinding white-gold light descending from parted clouds onto an empty ruined plaza
a serene domed sanctuary shimmering inside a translucent golden veil while storm clouds break harmlessly outside
a great pair of balanced golden scales overflowing with stacked coins beneath an arched treasury window
a gentle white elephant adorned in woven gold silk standing calmly amid the fallen masonry of a shattered statue

sets.name: Volcanic Woodcut
sets.style: Bold hand-carved relief woodcut print: stark soot-black ink, vermilion red, burnt ochre and raw warm paper, expressive gouged lines and jagged silhouettes.

items.subject: a stone archway twisting into a spiral of fiery ribbons, scattering bricks that transform into sparks and birds
a colossal meteor of scarlet flame crashing into a crowded volcanic caldera, sending shockwaves across the ridge
a grinning goblin engineer tossing a sizzling iron bomb into a towering heap of bronze gears and constructs
a fierce flame-crowned warrior raising a blazing spear as three trails of bright embers sweep upward
two shadowed raiders rushing out of a burning chapel carrying rolled scrolls and gleaming relics

sets.name: Moss & Ruin
sets.style: Atmospheric romantic landscape oil painting: deep forest viridian, weathered limestone, misty dappled shafts of warm morning sun, rich painterly foliage texture.

items.subject: a massive horned woodland beast bursting outward from a cracked mossy monolith in a misty forest clearing
a towering canopy of living emerald branches weaving tightly over a stone shrine to shield it from falling rubble
a calm cloaked druid standing beside a mossy stone well, lifting a glowing green leaf from dark water
a vibrant multi-plumed bird perched on a mossy ruined arch above a sunlit misty waterfall
a colossal moss-backed forest titan striding through splintered ancient pines as deer and wolves charge beneath it

sets.name: Abyssal Ink
sets.style: Sumi-e black ink wash with restrained bioluminescent teal and silver-grey highlights on textured cold-press paper, dramatic negative space and sweeping wet-on-wet brushwork.

items.subject: a single luminous white swan rising out of dark inked ripples as a shattered spell dissolves into mist
a solitary sphinx reflected in black water, five pale glowing lantern-orbs divided into two clusters between its paws
a sudden mountain gale sweeping hundreds of loose inked parchment leaves high across a pale moonlit mist
a heavy wall of dark ink-black rain pouring over sunken stone statues and rising floodwaters
a swirling cloud of shadowy night-moths descending onto a lone pale stone obelisk in a misty marsh

sets.name: Mythic Tapestry
sets.style: Medieval woven tapestry painting: rich burgundy, deep forest green, indigo and muted gold thread texture, stylized heraldic silhouettes and woven fabric grain.

items.subject: a solemn four-winged porcelain-masked angel hovering above a woven Gothic arch, four banners trailing below
a sly crowned goblin boss seated on an overturned wooden barrel surrounded by a sea of grinning spears and torches
an immense feathered elder dinosaur roaring atop a mossy stepped temple as jungle trees bend around it
a determined winged cleric in crimson robes summoning three vast silhouettes of angel, demon and dragon behind her
a primordial cosmic dragon with wings spanning the horizon, subtle bands of five-colour aurora woven through its scales

sets.name: Reliquary Lands
sets.style: Vintage travel poster gouache painting: layered flat atmospheric perspective, warm sunlit stone, muted olive, slate blue and dusty amber palette, bold clean shapes.

items.subject: a slender white-stone library tower rising from calm mirrored waters beneath wide peaceful clouds
twisted bleached cypress trees standing in still purple-grey marsh water with faint lantern mist
a terraced hillside grove of flowering fruit trees in five distinct seasonal hues overlooking a valley
a narrow lantern-lit stone alleyway slipping beneath a grand bridge into moonlit harbor shadows
a weathered monolithic desert mausoleum with a deep shadowed doorway glowing faintly amber within
